definition.variables: One binary face reversal; every C face is fixed to zero
definition.constraints: All indexed C-C/C-F/F-F edges with exactly two distinct nondegenerate incident faces: same original edge direction requires XOR1, opposite requires XOR0
definition.degenerate: Repeated vertex IDs or exactly zero FP64 triangle area; no near-zero threshold introduced
definition.components: Connected components of the eligible two-incidence constraint graph, including isolated faces
definition.repair: If parity-consistent and all fixed C anchors compatible, apply the unique anchored solution or an unanchored solution with minimum face ID unflipped; conflicted components remain entirely unchanged
definition.reversal: Per-face vertex order [0,2,1]; C face rows preserved byte-for-byte
definition.exclusions: Nonmanifold incidence, boundary edges, self-incidence, or a degenerate incident face produce no XOR constraint and are explicitly listed
definition.limitations: No vertex-link manifold, collision, overlap, watertightness, or semantic-attachment certificate. Duplicate faces are not repaired or removed.

rationale: Small deterministic analytic orientation fixtures, no GPU/model/real-mesh work
